function: Learned SCMA codebook mapping (autoencoders) and MLP-based SCMA decoding of delay-Doppler symbols, trained end-to-end in a downlink OTFS-SCMA system (pp. 2-3).
system: Downlink OTFS-SCMA, 6 users on 4 resource blocks, M=N=16, 4 GHz carrier, 15 kHz spacing; antenna count not stated; no RIS (pp. 2-4, Table I).
method: 12 three-layer fully connected autoencoders for codebooks plus 5-layer MLP decoder, 64 hidden neurons, trained jointly end-to-end with MSE loss and Adam (pp. 2-4, Table I).
data_channel: Simulated TDL-B channel, trained at 500 km/h; 20000 randomly generated training samples (Table I); no measured or public dataset (pp. 3-4).
test_conditions: Trained on 500 km/h TDL-B; tested on 500 km/h TDL-B, 1000 km/h TDL-B and 500 km/h TDL-A, for two frame sizes, and with CSI errors (p. 4, Figs. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned only: MP [9], GAEP [15], MAMP [16] after LMMSE detection, and cross-domain scheme [10] (Lc = 3, 5); no learned baseline (p. 4).
metrics: BER versus SNR with and without CSI errors, FLOPs, and running time (Figs. 3-6, pp. 4-5).
complexity: Complexity orders in O() form; FLOPs: MLP 14336 versus MP with 5 iterations 81920; running time versus MP and cross-domain schemes in Fig. 6 (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The TDL-B channel model is used" - TDL-B and TDL-A are named without a 3GPP citation; taken as the 3GPP TR 38.901 TDL profiles (see notes).
q2_support: p. 4: "trained on 500km/h TDL-B channel and tested on 500km/h TDL-B, 1000km/h TDL-B and 500km/h TDL-A" - a different speed and a different profile than in training.
q3_support: p. 4: "The MP, GAEP, and MAMP are all used for SCMA decoding after LMMSE detection" - with the cross-domain scheme [10] all baselines are non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared, and the MLP depths in Fig. 3 are variants of the proposed scheme.
q4_support: p. 5: "the FLOPs required for the designed MLP are 14336" - the complexity order is also given on p. 4 and running times in Fig. 6.
q5_support: p. 3: "The training dataset is obtained by continuing the process many times over" - data are simulated from random bits; no code or data link is given and no public or measured dataset is used.
notes: Included as area 4 by judgment: the learned part is SCMA codebook mapping and decoding on top of a classical time-domain LMMSE OTFS detector (p. 3), and the MLP decodes delay-Doppler symbols of a high-mobility OTFS link; if the reviewer reads it as multiple-access design only, the reason would be function. The number of antennas is never stated (OTFS admits a single-antenna link). q1: TDL-B and TDL-A are named without a 3GPP citation; reviewer to confirm they are the TR 38.901 TDL profiles. Table I and Figs. 3-6 were read from the page images (pp. 4-5).
